press_references.value: Hypercore Unveils First AI-Admin Agent To Redefine Operational Lifecycle of Private Credit Loans

product_launches.description: Hypercore launched the general availability of its AI Admin Agent, an AI-driven loan administration solution that automates the full post-close operational lifecycle for private credit funds on its SaaS platform.

overview_description.description: Hypercore provides a cloud-based loan management platform that supports lenders in handling loan portfolios from origination through repayment. The company’s software centralizes loan data, automates routine workflows, and tracks funding sources and performance metrics in a single system. Its tools also include customizable reporting and analytics features to help users monitor loans and generate insights. Hypercore’s platform is designed to replace manual processes and disparate spreadsheets with structured digital workflows that support ongoing loan operations.

about_short_description.short_description: Hypercore provides a cloud-based platform that manages loan portfolios from origination through repayment.

product.name: Loan Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing commercial and private credit loans from origination through maturity, including loan terms, schedules, balances, fees, amendments, and portfolio data.

product.name: Loan Servicing
product.description: A loan administration and paying agent service covering onboarding, register maintenance, calculations, payments, waterfalls, notices, covenant monitoring, reconciliation, and loan-level reporting.

product.name: AI Admin Agent
product.description: An AI-based loan administration service that executes recurring private credit workflows such as deal setup, calculations, allocations, payments, notices, reconciliation, monitoring, and reporting.

product.name: Pipeline Management
product.description: A loan origination and deal pipeline module for collecting borrower information, evaluating opportunities, managing workflows, and transferring approved deals into loan administration.

product.name: Funding Sources Management
product.description: A module for tracking capital providers, loan allocations, funding terms, liabilities, margins, returns, and payment schedules across syndicated and multi-source lending structures.

product.name: Reporting
product.description: A reporting and business intelligence module for analyzing loan, portfolio, risk, cash-flow, operational, regulatory, and funding-source data through dashboards, reports, exports, and queries.
